exposure: method of measuring the angle of progression (AoP)
Angle of progression (AoP) measured by transperineal ultrasound (manual sagittal, manual parasagittal, and automated parasagittal methods)
outcome: Inter- and intraobserver reliability of AoP measurements
Cesarean section (CS) for failure to progress (FTP)
cohort: 512 women with a singleton pregnancy undergoing induction of labor
finding: The manual parasagittal method demonstrated the greatest reliability for measuring AoP, and a model combining maternal factors, pregnancy characteristics, and ultrasound findings explained over half the variation in time to vaginal delivery.
